items.prompt: Given these two symbolic fractions, this one is greater. 5/3  8/3
One fraction is greater than another fraction if it shades more space. So, this fraction is greater than this one, because it shades more space.
items.demo: This fraction is greater, because *it shades more space*.

items.prompt: Looking at the symbols for each fraction, each symbol shows the same number of parts per whole unit…
items.demo: …and then the fraction that shades more space has a *bigger number on top*.

items.prompt: Which fraction is greater? How do you know?  5/3  8/3
items.expected: 8/3 is greater, because it has more parts.
items.demo: *8/3* is greater, because it has more parts.
choices: 8/3 is greater, because it has more parts.
Equal bottom numbers mean the fractions must have equal values.
A larger top number makes each individual part larger.
